title: Why Java packages are used
answer: Packages create namespaces, organize related types, support access control through package-private and protected rules, and make large codebases easier to navigate. They also prevent simple-name collisions because the fully qualified class name includes the package. AeroTopo groups domain, persistence, service, configuration, GIS, I/O, and operational concerns under `com.aerotopo`, so developers can locate responsibilities and reason about dependencies instead of searching one flat directory.
